senses.zh_definition: Robertson：通常音译为“罗伯逊”的姓氏，历史构词义为“Robert 之子”；输入中具体的人物或其他同名对象尚未确定。
senses.en_definition: A surname historically meaning “son of Robert”; the particular person or other namesake intended by the input is unidentified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga yang secara sejarah bermaksud anak kepada Robert; individu atau entiti khusus yang dirujuk dalam input belum dikenal pasti.
senses.nuances: 这是专名说明，不是 DBP 官方普通词释义。姓氏来源参见 [Robertson surname history](https://forebears.io/surnames/robertson)，其中收录历史姓氏词典的解释。历史构词义不能推断现代持名者的父亲姓名。读音应遵从持名者；输入没有足以确定该对象读音的资料，故 IPA 保留 null。下列为教学搭配及虚构情景，排名仅沿用输入。

etymology.historical_story: Robertson belongs to the patronymic tradition: its historical construction identifies someone as a son of Robert. Historical surname dictionaries document this interpretation and its Scottish connections. As an inherited surname, however, it identifies a family rather than stating the current bearer's father's name. Its presence in Malay text remains a proper-name occurrence, not evidence of Malay derivation. [Source](https://forebears.io/surnames/robertson).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Robert + son 联想“Robert 的儿子”，记住姓氏来源；日常称呼仍把 Robertson 当作完整姓氏。
